text: For the synthesis of the micrometric silica particles, 85 mL of EtOH and 40 mL of distilled water were added to a 250 mL flask, and the mixture was stirred at 1000 evolutions per minute (rpm). Then, 30 mL of TEOS were slowly poured in, and after 30 min, 8 mL of NH4OH were added to the flask.

source.title: Janus Nanoparticles by Pickering Emulsions: A Versatile Approach for the Selective Functionalization of SiO2
